title: Bicep: From Your First Line to Enterprise Server Plans
description: Read, write and debug Azure Bicep with annotated blueprints, real local compilation, JSON comparisons and beginner practice. Build toward private multi-server plans without automatic deployment.
baseline: Azure Bicep / ARM · Windows workstation and PowerShell · browser compiler practice · live Azure steps optional
prerequisite: Some IT familiarity helps. No programming or Bicep knowledge is assumed. Start at the first lesson; browser compilation requires no Azure account.
supplies: A modern browser. The compiler downloads on demand and runs locally; it does not send your source to Azure.
For local-file work: VS Code with Microsoft Bicep extension and Azure CLI from the official links.
Only for optional live validation/deployment: an approved Azure subscription, permissions, training resource group and budget. No Azure credentials belong in this website.
